items.title: Hackers are exploiting ArrayOS AG VPN flaw to plant webshells
items.description: Threat actors have been exploiting a command injection vulnerability in Array AG Series VPN devices to plant webshells and create rogue users. [...]

items.title: NCSC's ‘Proactive Notifications’ warns orgs of flaws in exposed devices
items.description: The UK's National Cyber Security Center (NCSC) announced the testing phase of a new service called Proactive Notifications, designed to inform organizations in the country of vulnerabilities present in their environment. [...]

items.title: CISA Warns of 'Ongoing' Brickstorm Backdoor Attacks
items.description: State-sponsored actors tied to China continue to target VMware vSphere environments at government and technology organizations.

items.title: Predator spyware uses new infection vector for zero-click attacks
items.description: The Predator spyware from surveillance company Intellexa has been using a zero-click infection mechanism dubbed "Aladdin" that compromised specific targets when simply viewing a malicious advertisement. [...]

items.title: CISA Publishes Security Guidance for Using AI in OT
items.description: Global cybersecurity agencies published guidance regarding AI deployments in operational technology, a backbone of critical infrastructure.

items.title: Russia blocks FaceTime and Snapchat over use in terrorist attacks
items.description: Russian telecommunications watchdog Roskomnadzor has blocked access to Apple's FaceTime video conferencing platform and the Snapchat instant messaging service, claiming they're being used to coordinate terrorist attacks. [...]

items.title: India Rolls Back Order to Preinstall Cybersecurity App on Smartphones
items.description: The Ministry of Communications on had asked smartphone makers to install the government’s “Sanchar Saathi” app within 90 days and to prevent users from disabling it. The post India Rolls Back Order to Preinstall Cybersecurity App on Smartphones appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: CISA warns of Chinese "BrickStorm" malware attacks on VMware servers
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned network defenders of Chinese hackers backdooring VMware vSphere servers with Brickstorm malware. [...]
